messages:
mira: dropping a refreshed invite-drawer mock (figma link). Need quick feedback on three things: roles matrix density, SSO toggle wording/placement, and a tiny pattern to jump to audit logs from the invite flow.

devin: rows look tight when descriptions exist. +6px vertical padding and a clearer 1px divider would help scan. make headers sticky for long lists.

kevin: agree on padding. note: sticky + virtualization needs a stable sticky-offset with drawer chrome. focus ring contrast on row select is low
